svg.text: LT14-C01 · Curve demand and revised body envelope
Three large drivers retained; 50 m remains a design target, not the approved minimum operating radius.
POWERED-AXLE PLAN · REQUIRED 50 m CURVE PLACEMENT (LATERAL OFFSET EXAGGERATED)
Outer axles: +12.015 lateral; middle axle: −12.015 (opposite signs on right curves)
Leading truck: centre X1525, lateral115.159, yaw−4.043°; wheelbase1050
Trailing truck: centre X8475, lateral107.690, yaw+3.928°; wheelbase950
BODY FIT: cylinders Ø400 ×550, centre X2450 / Y±1000 / Z1030; lower shell edge Z1525
FRAME PROPOSAL: box304.8 ×112.4 ×9.525, centre Y±320, top1350; inner face±263.8
Fixed straight horn guides still clash with steered axleboxes. This drawing specifies demanded motion,
not a completed steering linkage. Narrow frame section and all mounts require a new structural check.
LT14 · mm unless noted · Development dimensions · Do not scale · Not released for fabrication
